title: Psalm 142: A Prayer from the Cave
summary: Hiding in a cave, David cries aloud to the LORD and pours out his complaint. His spirit is faint, a trap lies along his path, and no one cares for his life. He declares that the LORD is his refuge and his portion in the land of the living, and asks to be set free from his prison so that he can praise God's name among the righteous.

from.where: The Study Bible's notes on Psalm 142
from.text: Psalm 142 is a short individual lament

line: Hiding in a cave, David pours out his complaint: his spirit is faint, no one cares for his life, and the LORD is his refuge and his portion.
guide: Pour out your complaint without tidying it up; you may say honestly that no one cares. Then look at the end, where he hopes the righteous will gather around him again, and ask who is in a cave right now with no one at their right hand.

care.text: If ‘no one cares for my soul’ is how you feel, please hear this: the person who prayed this psalm felt it too, and God kept his prayer in the Bible. Loneliness is not a sign that God has forgotten you. Tell God, as this singer did. Then, if you can, tell one person: a pastor, a friend, a neighbour. If loneliness has become despair, or you have thoughts of hurting yourself, speak to someone today. The Find Help page on this site lists places to turn.

stanzas.title: Crying out and pouring out the complaint
No one at my right hand, no refuge
You are my refuge and my portion
Rescue me from prison so I may praise

verses.t: A Maskil of David, when he was in the cave. A prayer. I cry aloud to the LORD; I lift my voice to the LORD for mercy.
I pour out my complaint before Him; I reveal my trouble to Him.
Although my spirit grows faint within me, You know my way. Along the path I travel they have hidden a snare for me.
Look to my right and see; no one attends to me. There is no refuge for me; no one cares for my soul.
I cry to You, O LORD: “You are my refuge, my portion in the land of the living.”
Listen to my cry, for I am brought quite low. Rescue me from my pursuers, for they are too strong for me.
Free my soul from prison, that I may praise Your name. The righteous will gather around me because of Your goodness to me.
